title: Export a user's files into an export folder

defects.what: A user-chosen absolute name such as /tmp/x.txt replaces the export folder in os.path.join, so the file is written outside it.
str.lstrip removes any of the characters of draft- from the start, so data.csv is exported as .csv.
The extension is taken from the first dot, so photo.v2.jpeg is not renamed to photo.v2.jpg.

edits.replace:
stem, dot, ext = name.partition(".")
    ext = dot + ext

defects.what: The filtered folder list is rebound instead of assigned in place, so os.walk still enters hidden folders such as .git and exports their files.

edits.find: dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
edits.replace: dirs = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]

defects.what: The compress command is run through the shell with an unquoted path, so a path with a space fails.
os.path.isfile follows symbolic links, so a link to a file outside the folder is exported.
The export folder is only created when a file is copied, so an empty source leaves no export folder.
level 0 is falsy, so `level or DEFAULT_LEVEL` compresses at level 6 instead of storing.

edits.find: level = DEFAULT_LEVEL if level is None else level
